top_choice_rationale: P001 is a continuous, mature discovery arc (Holst on GLP-1 secretion and action, Mojsov on the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology and the therapeutic concept) confirmed by independent outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-person allocation and the citation worded around physiology and the active form do not split the achievement or adjudicate the Habener-group priority question. No member showed that Mojsov's contribution was not decisive, so I prefer this to no award; the residual attribution risk does not outweigh the merit.
